description_en: Calls the BatchExecuteStatement operation to execute batch SQL statements on a set of data
description_zh: 调用BatchExecuteStatement接口对一组数据执行批处理SQL语句
kebab_example: aliyun rds-data batch-execute-statement --secret-arn acs:rds-api:cn-hangzhou:1266348003000000:rds-db-credentials/mySecret-Uy0000 --resource-arn acs:rds:cn-hangzhou:1266348003000000:dbinstance/rm-1234567890abc0000 --database test --sql insert_into_users_name_values_:name --transaction-id 86090000-94e1-45ce-8e25-354e3dd80000 --parameter-sets '["example-string"]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchExecuteStatement

parameters.help_en: The user credential for the Data API account. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter. Format: `acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`
parameters.help_zh: Data API账号的用户凭证，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取该参数的值。格式如下：0
parameters.name: secret_arn

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the resource that the user wants to access. Format: ```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

Parameter description:

regionId: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain this value.
accountId: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain this value.
instanceId: The instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
用于指向用户希望访问的资源，格式如下：```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

参数说明如下：

regionId：地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取。
accountId：阿里云账号ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取。
instanceId：实例ID
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en:
The SQL statement to execute.

The BatchExecuteStatement operation is typically used to execute INSERT and UPDATE statements
parameters.help_zh:
需要执行的SQL 语句。

BatchExecuteStatement接口通常多执行INSERT和UPDATE语句
parameters.name: sql

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transaction that has been started. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446897.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 已启动的事务ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446897.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: transaction_id
